title: S&P 500 closes lower, Nasdaq falls more than 1% as chip stocks suffer: AI hyperscaler capex slowdown fears spread
summary: S&P 500 lost 1.5% for the week ending July 17; Nasdaq fell 2.9%; PHLX SOX is down ~11% over the past month and ~20% from late-June peak. Reuters analysis (July 17) highlights that some investors are positioning for slower hyperscaler spending growth — UBS models 76% capex growth in 2026 decelerating to 25% in 2027 and just 6% in 2028.
why: 半导体板块深度回调波及英伟达、美光、SK 海力士 ADR 等核心持仓；sell-put 策略需关注 IV 抬升带来的期权溢价变化，短期可考虑卖出更高行权价 put 锁定溢价。

title: CXMT Seeks $8.55B in Marquee IPO — Asia's Biggest IPO of 2026, Listing July 27 on STAR Market; A-share liquidity drain fears emerge
summary: China's ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) priced its STAR Market IPO at 8.66 yuan/share, raising ~57.9 billion yuan ($8.55B) — the largest Chinese A-share semiconductor IPO ever, surpassing SMIC's 2020 offering. Shares list July 27. Simultaneously, Unitree Robotics received regulatory IPO approval for STAR Board. The Shanghai Composite fell 3.05% the prior week amid concerns that CXMT plus upcoming mega-listings could drain market liquidity.
why: A 股史上最大芯片 IPO 即将挂牌（7月27日），近期流动性已受冲击（上证综指周跌3.05%）；CXMT 若量产 HBM 将对 SK 海力士/美光形成竞争压力，需关注其技术进度对 HBM 定价格局的影响。

title: SK Hynix Korea shares clock worst-ever single session (-15.4%), KOSPI triggers 20-min circuit breaker; ADRs (SKHY) recently debuted on Nasdaq
summary: SK Hynix fell a record 15.4% in Seoul on July 13 — two trading days after its Nasdaq ADR debut (SKHY) — after Korea Investment & Securities cut its Q2 blended DRAM ASP growth estimate from 50% QoQ to 28.9% QoQ and projected Q2 operating profit 8% below consensus. The rout dragged Samsung, Micron, and SanDisk lower; South Korea's KOSPI halted for 20 minutes. SK Hynix holds ~56% global HBM market share.
why: SK 海力士是英伟达/AMD HBM 主供应商，其 DRAM ASP 预期下调直接传导至 HBM 需求叙事；ADR（SKHY）已在 Nasdaq 上市，高 IV 下可评估 sell-put 机会；事件也令美光短期承压。

title: 国家统计局：2026年上半年GDP同比增长4.7%，货物贸易首破25万亿，新动能贡献超四成
summary: 7月15日国家统计局发布：上半年GDP同比增长4.7%（Q1为5.0%），总体运行在合理区间。货物贸易进出口历史同期首破25万亿元。服务业增加值同比+5.2%，贡献率66.1%。6月城镇调查失业率5.0%，CPI同比+1.0%，PPI同比+1.5%。
why: GDP 增速较 Q1 放缓，内需偏弱对消费港股（美团、海底捞、蜜雪冰城）构成负面背景；贸易数据亮眼利好出境游复苏（携程），新动能（数字经济）超四成贡献利好腾讯、阿里等科技股长期逻辑。

title: Fed Monetary Policy Report July 2026: Rates held at 3.50-3.75%, forward guidance abandoned; AI capex and Middle East risks cited
summary: The Fed's July 2026 MPR reaffirms the federal funds rate at 3.50%-3.75% (unchanged since June). Chair Kevin Warsh says the Fed will no longer provide traditional forward guidance, signaling greater meeting-by-meeting flexibility. The report cites elevated inflation partly from Middle East energy shocks, while noting strong business investment driven by AI data-center construction. Futures markets price rates rising toward ~4% by year-end.
why: 联储放弃前瞻指引增加加息不确定性，高 IV 环境整体利好 sell-put 策略；维持高利率对科技成长股估值有压制，但 AI 资本开支强劲叙事不变，英伟达等 AI 基础设施受益逻辑仍成立。

title: 老铺黄金（6181.HK）市值蒸发逾1200亿港元：金价上半年跌超28%，门店冷清，天猫Q2销售同比暴跌63%
summary: 国际金价从2026年1月底约5599美元/盎司回落至7月中旬约3973美元/盎司，跌幅超28%。老铺黄金股价从历史高点（2025年7月约1065港元）跌至约370港元，累计跌幅逾65%，市值蒸发超1200亿港元。高盛追踪显示Q2天猫旗舰店销售同比暴跌63%（Q1曾同比+155%）；实探报道门店客流冷清，二手折价。估值从50倍PE压缩至约12倍，与传统金店无异。高盛将目标价从1108港元大幅下调至650港元，维持买入评级；瑞银认为当前估值属超卖状态。
why: 硬奢溢价模式被金价暴跌打穿；高盛维持买入但大幅下调目标价，适合等待止跌信号后 sell put（600-700港元区间估值支撑较厚）；先需核实金价走势及 Q3 销售恢复迹象。

title: Tesla (TSLA) Q2 2026 earnings call July 22: record 480,126 deliveries; options price +/-7% swing; Robotaxi Cybercab and Optimus Gen 3 in spotlight
summary: Tesla reports Q2 2026 results Wednesday July 22 at 5:30 PM ET. The company reported record Q2 deliveries of 480,126 vehicles (vs analyst consensus of 406,024) and 13.5 GWh energy storage deployed. Analysts forecast revenue ~$26.4B, EPS ~$0.54. Options markets imply ~7% post-earnings price swing. Morgan Stanley says investor debate centers on Robotaxi Cybercab timelines (steering-wheel-less Cybercab now testing in Austin) and Optimus Gen 3 prototype public unveiling timeline.
why: 本周三（7月22日）业绩是特斯拉最近期重大催化剂；高 IV 下可考虑卖出宽式跨期期权捕捉波动率溢价；Robotaxi/Optimus 若超预期股价或大涨，建议消化催化剂后再 sell-put 以控制单向风险。

title: Google Gemini 3.5 Pro launch delayed — Bloomberg exclusive: internal goals missed, engineers fear falling behind Anthropic and OpenAI
summary: Bloomberg reported July 16 that Google is months behind schedule on Gemini 3.5 Pro, its most capable AI model, due to unmet coding and reasoning targets. Internal engineers and managers are frustrated, with many worried Google risks losing its AI competitive edge. Separately, Google said Gemini has crossed 900 million monthly users in 230+ countries; Chrome Gemini features rolled out to UK users July 14.
why: 谷歌 AI 旗舰模型延迟发布暴露其与 Anthropic/OpenAI 竞争差距，短期利空 GOOG/GOOGL 估值；AI 军备竞赛溢价可能更多流向 Anthropic 而非谷歌；持有或 sell-put 前需重新评估 AI 竞争力定价风险。

title: 泡泡玛特（9992.HK）段永平第三度加仓：7月6日买入1059万股（约15.89亿港元），持股升至7.65%成第二大股东
summary: 据港交所7月10日披露，段永平通过 H&H International Investment LLC 于7月6日场内增持泡泡玛特1059万股，成交最高价150港元，合计约15.89亿港元；增持后总持股达1.0186亿股，持股比例由6.85%升至7.65%，本年三轮增持合计耗资超38亿港元。泡泡玛特当前股价约150港元，较历史高点约335港元已跌逾55%。
why: 段永平长期持有的里程碑动作，对应港股持仓参考价值高；股价跌逾55%为 sell-put 提供安全垫（行权价120-130港元附近估值支撑较厚），但也需关注 Labubu 需求延续性和新 IP 孵化进展。
source: 财联社 / 港交所披露

title: Circle (CRCL) wins OCC national trust bank approval (July 10), first stablecoin issuer with federal charter; stock fell ~17% on Open USD rival threat
summary: Circle received final OCC approval July 10 to establish Circle National Trust, the first stablecoin issuer with a U.S. federal banking charter. Shares initially surged ~16% pre-market, closing up ~5%. However, a Coinbase/BlackRock-led consortium subsequently announced Open USD, a new competing stablecoin, triggering a ~16-17% CRCL decline. Mizuho (via CoinDesk July 13) says OCC approval does not resolve USDC growth or competition risks. Current USDC circulation: ~$73B.
why: 监管牌照利好短暂被竞争威胁抵消，股价大幅波动创造高 IV sell-put 机会；若 Open USD 规模扩张成功，Circle 市场份额长期存疑；适合小仓位测试 sell-put（行权价偏低，对应较高保证金回报率）。

title: Intel (INTC) to report Q2 2026 earnings July 23; stock up 160% YTD; analysts eye 18A foundry ramp and $14.4B revenue
summary: Intel confirmed Q2 2026 results on July 23 after market close, with earnings call at 2 PM PDT. Analyst consensus: revenue ~$14.4B, EPS ~$0.10 (vs -$0.26 a year ago). Intel has rallied ~160% in 2026 amid AI infrastructure tailwinds. Key focus: 18A manufacturing process progress, AI server share, PC demand durability. Semiconductor sector down ~11% over the past month — sector weakness may create post-earnings noise.
why: 本周四（7月23日）是英特尔关键业绩催化剂；今年涨幅160%设置高预期门槛，若指引不及预期叠加半导体弱势，下行风险显著；关注 18A 代工进展是否兑现，若兑现可作为 sell-put 支撑依据。

title: 阿里巴巴（9988.HK/BABA）Q1 FY27前瞻大超预期：阿里云收入增速加速至约45%，港股盘中涨超13%
summary: 7月8日机构发布阿里巴巴 FY27 Q1（2026年4-6月）前瞻：阿里云季度收入增速加速至约45%（市场预期约30%），EBITA margin从9.1%扩至低双位数；淘宝闪购单季减亏约80亿元；集团整体收入预计同比增约9%。港股当日盘中涨超13%，收涨12.21%至107.5港元。正式 Q1 财报预计8月正式发布。
why: 阿里云 45% 增速超预期是最重要信号，AI 云化需求快速落地；若正式财报兑现此预期，将触发港股互联网板块估值重估；当前可评估 sell-put（行权价90-95港元区间有技术支撑）或增加正股配置。
source: 新浪财经 / 华尔街见闻

title: SanDisk (SNDK) and Kioxia begin 10th-gen BiCS10 NAND production (332 layers, +59% density); SanDisk secures multi-year Meta NAND supply deal
summary: SanDisk and Kioxia began producing 10th-generation BiCS10 3D NAND at Kitakami Fab2 (Japan) on July 3. BiCS10 stacks 332 layers, achieves density >29 Gb/mm2 (+59% vs prior gen), interface speed 4.8 Gbps (+33%), and 34% lower output power. SanDisk separately secured a multi-year NAND flash supply deal with Meta for AI infrastructure build-out. The SanDisk-Kioxia JV was extended through 2034. SNDK stock retested $1,500 amid NAND competition concerns.
why: BiCS10 量产+Meta 长约强化 SNDK 在 AI 存储市场的竞争地位；NAND vs HBM 资本开支博弈是关键风险，需关注 ASP 走势；NAND 供应商（SNDK/Kioxia/三星）竞争激烈，适合持续跟踪而非激进建仓。

title: 美团（3690.HK）即时零售日单量峰值破1.5亿创历史新高；Keeta海外覆盖香港、沙特、科威特、巴西
summary: 7月美团披露：即时零售日订单量峰值突破1.5亿单（全量配送平均时效34分钟），刷新历史纪录。Keeta已进驻香港、沙特、阿联酋及科威特，并在巴西采用新运营模式；中东地区已呈现规模效益，单位经济改善明显。另，美团自研大模型 LongCat-2.0（万亿参数，5万卡国产算力集群推理）于7月6日正式全面开源。
why: 即时零售破亿单叠加持续减亏，验证美团核心业务护城河；Keeta 国际化扩张是长期增量叙事；结合阿里淘宝闪购减亏加速，两者竞争格局趋于稳定，为 sell-put 提供更确定性支撑。

title: Palantir (PLTR) confirms Q2 2026 earnings on Aug 3; analysts forecast $1.8B revenue (+80% YoY), EPS $0.35 (+115% YoY)
summary: Palantir confirmed Q2 2026 results August 3 after market close with webcast at 5:00 PM ET. Wall Street projects ~$1.8B revenue (+80% YoY) and EPS of $0.35 (more than double year-ago). Q1 2026 context: US revenue +104% YoY, total revenue +85% YoY; FY 2026 guidance raised to 71% YoY growth. Stock has pulled back with broader tech sector but FY guidance momentum remains intact.
why: Palantir 政府+商业 AI 软件双轮驱动，8月3日业绩是下一个关键验证窗口；当前 IV 因板块回调抬升，sell-put（行权价70-80美元区间）可锁定溢价；FY2026指引71%增长若兑现将强化长期持仓逻辑。
